text: get_idea_context fails on ideas with long descriptions: it searches with the description, over the 2000-character query limit
description: Found by Claude 2026-11-20 on ideas.commons-hub.at: get_idea_context for d4203221 returned a zod error "Too big: expected string to have <=2000 characters" at path query. The related-ideas lookup passes the idea's text and description as a search query, and the search procedure caps the query at 2000 characters. Fix: cut the query (text plus the beginning of the description) to the limit before searching, and add a test with a long description.

status.comment: 2026-11-22: the related-ideas query (text plus description) is cut to MAX_SEARCH_QUERY_CHARS (2000, now in shared/constants.ts and used by the backend search procedures) in packages/mcp/src/tools/ideas.ts ideaContext. Evidence: new test 'get_idea_context works for an idea whose description exceeds the search query limit' in mcp tools-ideas.test.ts reproduced the zod 'Too big' error before the fix; all 20 tests in that file pass under Node 22 (the dev stack's version; with system Node 26 better-sqlite3 fails to load). tsc clean for shared, backend, mcp. The agent-tools getIdeaContext does no semantic search, so it was not affected. The running MCP server needs /mcp reconnect to pick it up.
